purpose: Instruction tuning after the fresh 10M-class base-model run and before the locked 75-item evaluation.
authorship: All dialogue text in this dataset was newly authored for this project; no third-party text was copied.

held_out_evaluation_policy.policy: Do not copy, paraphrase, import, or train on any locked evaluation item. Run the locked suite only after instruction tuning is complete.
held_out_evaluation_policy.note: The supplied report confirms the 75-item suite is evaluation_only and exclude_from_training; the actual 75 prompt texts were not included in the report, so lexical overlap against those prompts cannot be independently checked from this PDF alone.

recommended_sequence: Load the existing fresh base-model checkpoint.
Run the locked 75-item suite in a clean evaluation session with the project's existing administration settings.
Score and compare against the 0.04/4.00 baseline without mixing evaluation prompts into training.
